name: Chicago
tagline: The building where deep dish pizza was born in 1943, and the theatrical cuisine that redefined American fine dining.

Alinea.description: Experimental, theatrical gastronomy from chef Grant Achatz, a world reference for over a decade. Two Michelin stars.

Pizzeria Uno.description: The original Ohio Street building where deep dish pizza was born in 1943.

Lou Malnati's.description: The deep dish pizza Chicagoans swear is the best, ordered even for birthdays.

Smyth.description: Seasonal farm-to-table cuisine in the West Loop, the second Chicago restaurant to earn three Michelin stars.

Portillo's.description: The chain that defined Italian beef and the Chicago-style hot dog, as much a food destination as a fast chain.
